Name: Strawberry milk cows
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
🌸 Strawberry Cow
Bring sweetness to your farm with the Strawberry Cow. These cute pink cows can be bought from Marnie and they produce Strawberry Milk. Put the milk into a Cheese Machine to make Strawberry Butter. Both the milk and butter are consumable and profitable, adding a cozy touch to your farm life.

Requirements:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

Make sure both are installed before using the mod.
Installation:
Download the zip file and extract it.
Move the extracted folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
Example path:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

Open the game with SMAPI and you will find the Strawberry Cow at Marnie’s Ranch.
NotesStrawberry Cows act like regular cows but with pink charm and special milk.
Strawberry Milk can be turned into Strawberry Butter using the Cheese Machine.
Both items can be consumed or sold for profit.

If you notice any needed updates with my mods or have any questions please let me know I'm very active on NexusMods and Curseforge and I always try to handle the issue as soon as possible. Thank you!

CreditsCreated by Abrah Mods
